principle: BADGES_SHOULD_BE_EASY_TO_EARN_AT_FIRST; DIFFICULTY MAY INCREASE AT TIER PROMOTION, NOT BY MAKING FIRST ACQUISITION RARE.

first_acquisition.rule: Use the minimum direct evidence needed to prove the badge behavior without guessing.

reaward_and_stars.rule: Distinct qualifying events may reaward the same badge under the existing star progression.

tier_promotion.rule: If difficulty is increased, do it at tier-promotion boundaries rather than first acquisition.
tier_promotion.invariant: Tier strengthening must not retroactively block the initial badge identity.

source_scope.rule: This policy does not automatically authorize a new source app for a badge. App-source scope changes remain explicit authority decisions.
